Resolve observer team byte using 141eefb60. If map flag && bRevealWithMap, set team bit then return true. Otherwise if cached team bit is set, return true.

Read actor root-component world locations, using native zero-vector fallback for absent root. If bDistanceCheck2D, clear both Z values. Return false if distance squared > Radius*Radius. Negative or NaN Radius skips distance check.

Obtain observer root quaternion forward vector (native fallback if absent root). Compute owner location minus observer location in 3D, normalize only when length squared > 1e-8 using native reciprocal-square-root plus two refinement steps. Return false unless dot(observerForward,direction) >= 0.642f; unordered dot also returns false. DistanceCheck2D does not affect facing.

Call actor virtual slot 0x5f8 for observer and owner positions (eye-viewpoint-shaped; symbolic identity unresolved). Trace observer position to owner position, numeric collision channel 3, trace complex true, observer ignored, CheckProximityLOS trace tag. Return false only if blocking trace reports true and resolved hit actor differs from owner.
If OnceSeenAlwaysSeen, resolve observer team byte again and set cache bit. Return true.
